author: Reign
label: Capri on your desktop
description: Capri, the hologram from Voxta for Cyberpunk, as a companion on your Windows desktop. She stands on your taskbar, talks with you out loud in her own voice, lip syncs, glitches and zips around the screen in a crack of lightning. Play downloads her app the first time and starts her; she brings her own character. Work in progress.
